newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber close lower ahead of housing report.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber close lower ahead of housing report.

text.p: Profit taking and evening up trade ahead of Thursday's U.S. housing starts report weighed on CME lumber futures, which closed lower, traders said.
Lumber ended $4.30 to $0.50 per tbf lower with March off most at $411.50 and May off $1.90 at $388.70 per tbf.
Initial carryover demand lacked followthrough after filling a gap in the charts at $420 in March. Prices then drifted lower most of the day as demand was lacking ahead of the report, traders said.
Cash market strength Tuesday did not carry over to Wednesday, which encouraged selling in futures.
Random Lengths reported cash spruce at $412 per tbf, up $4 from midweek and up $7 from last Friday.
Expectations on the housing report for January averaged 1.42 million units, which would be up from December's 1.33 million units.
